missionPremiseVerified.claim: Option (a), operator ruling 2026-09-14: servedProvenanceTokens admits a non-string OBJECT as a provenance token, so an earned (facts-free) retirement's mirrored zoning REFUSAL object is graded by S13 and rejected, making the walk red on 16 hollow Bastrop nodes.
verifiedAtSourceThisRun: src/stages/grade/s-rules.mjs:698-705 `servedProvenanceTokens(body)` maps parcelSource/landUseSource/zoningSource and filters `.filter((t) => t != null && t !== false)` -- a non-string object passes the filter and lands in the token position. CONFIRMED by read.
src/stages/grade/s-rules.mjs:742-748 hands that token to gradeS13 as `provenance: { source: 'served-facets.provenance', token }`; when token == null it passes provenance:null.

src/stages/grade/s-rules.mjs:627-658 gradeS13 returns failClosed with 'provenance <token> is placeholder or off the allowlist' for an off-allowlist token, and unmeasured('S13', ...) when no provenance pair is supplied. CONFIRMED.
src/stages/grade/v-rules.mjs:74-76 `isNonPassGrade` returns `grade === 'FAIL' || grade === 'KNOWN_OPEN'` -- UNMEASURED is NOT a non-pass grade. CONFIRMED.

src/jobs/verify-walk.mjs:748-757 promotes `firstSFail(sGrades)` over a grade whose `verdict === 'pass'`; a RECORD_RETIRED pass (verify-walk.mjs:511-517) is therefore replaced by the failing S13. CONFIRMED by read (the dispatch's O11 refinement, not the dispatch's own text).
